name: Jotform AI Agents
desc: Customer-support agents trained on your forms and data, no code.
desc_zh: 用你的表单和数据训练客服 Agent，无需写代码。
solves: Deploys a support agent that already knows your forms and order fields, so it stops asking users to repeat themselves.
solves_zh: 上线即懂你的表单和订单字段的客服 Agent，不用让用户重复说明。
best_for: Reaching for it when support volume is real but engineering help is not available.
best_for_zh: 客服量真实存在但没有工程资源时。
notes: 外部发现渠道补录：Similarweb global AI traffic list, #25 with ~41.3M monthly visits (Jotform AI Agents)。来源：https://www.jotform.com/blog/announcing-ai-agents-for-shopify/
